actualCommands.result: Two authorized device entries; adb 1.0.41 / platform-tools 37.0.1-15733141. Serials intentionally omitted.

actualCommands.command: adb shell getprop ro.product.model; getprop ro.build.version.release; getprop ro.build.version.sdk; wm size; dumpsys package kr.danpan.omok; dumpsys wifi; dumpsys connectivity
actualCommands.result: Captured model, OS/API, installed version, notification permission, common Wi-Fi network/subnet/gateway and Internet VALIDATED state. SSID/BSSID/IP identifiers excluded from retained evidence.

actualCommands.command: adb shell am start -n kr.danpan.omok/.MainActivity; adb shell input tap; adb shell screencap -p
actualCommands.result: Both installed app activities launched. UI taps and screenshots were used for live discovery and challenge flow.

tests.name: install, permission state, same-Wi-Fi discovery, selection, challenge and acceptance
tests.details: Both current version apps installed/launched. One device had notification permission denied and one granted; discovery still worked. Same-SSID search reached one peer on both sides after pressing rescan; one momentary asymmetric/stale peer list cleared after rescan. A request appeared on the authority tablet and was accepted. Internet-free, denied-permission UI, guest network and >2 peers were not tested.

tests.name: board candidate, commit, authority validation, both boards/revisions
tests.details: Both previous test rounds entered revision 0 games with correct black-to-move/60-second state. A translucent H8 candidate was visible in a round, but a committed move was not obtained before the live turn deadline. No same-revision committed move on both devices, duplicate move, stale revision, unauthorized move, or DB failure was verified in this run. Turn timeout then ended the game. The app's 60-second rule was not changed.

tests.name: result, PNG, rematch and role/color assignment
tests.details: Prior device run verified timeout result, Gallery-opened PNG, and rematch creating a new empty revision-0 game with requester WHITE/responder BLACK while authority remained guest1. This follow-up also reached another accepted challenge but it timed out. Five-in-a-row, resign, draw, disconnect result, PNG share/win marker, and host-role swap are not verified.

tests.name: chat and IME
tests.details: The chat panel and empty state were visible. A prior draft remained unsent. No delivered message, duplicate-ID retry, Korean IME composition behavior, message cap, or security input test was confirmed.

tests.name: solo offline, screen lifecycle, network reconnection, updates
tests.details: Existing evidence shows Android solo screen and bot move. This run did not disable all network routes, test fully offline restart, screen-off behavior during a live match, app/process termination, Wi-Fi reconnect/IP change, or update while in a match.

tests.name: Android PNG storage and opening
tests.details: A timeout result PNG was saved and opened in Samsung Gallery. It showed names, colors, reason, complete empty board and save time. No winning-line PNG or share operation.

tests.name: real communication viewer, transport metadata and OSI distinction
tests.details: No actual communication-viewer event list was inspected and no packet capture was made. Source documentation is not a runtime observation.

tests.name: participant/host loss, restart, deadlines and storage policy
tests.details: No app force-stop, participant exit, host exit/restart, screen-off, Wi-Fi reconnect, deadline-boundary or storage error injection was performed.

tests.name: same-router internal LAN with Internet blocked
tests.details: Wi-Fi reported VALIDATED/INTERNET and phone mobile IMS remained connected. The test did not establish an isolated Internet-off condition.

tests.name: guest network/client isolation failure guidance
tests.details: No router configuration was changed; no guest SSID or client-isolation network was available for a controlled test.

tests.name: swap authority host and participant devices
tests.details: The current installation UUID election kept the tablet as authority. Reversing it would require resetting/recreating an installation identity; app data was not cleared because that would erase the devices' local game/session data.

tests.name: two simultaneous challenges, more than one opponent, duplicate move/chat
tests.details: Only two physical Android devices were available. No third peer or independent device-generated simultaneous challenge was available; duplicate move/chat were not confirmed.
